builder.objective: Finish V3-01 from the existing V3 domain baseline. Consolidate shared validation, make replay robust against malformed settlements, add period/view helpers without resetting perpetual balances, add preconditions preventing invalid/over-settlement, and add randomized/property-style invariant tests. Preserve the working zero-sum contribution and expense math already present; do not rebuild it from scratch.
builder.scope: Domain entities/calculations/tests and directly necessary package/config work only. Use V2 read-only reference when helpful, but V3 semantics win. No UI tranche yet except changes strictly required by domain contracts.
acceptance: contribution ledger sum is zero for valid randomized cases
money ledger sum is exactly zero per currency with integer minor units
historical Minutes and Points never silently mix or reinterpret
cross-ledger settlement validates snapshotted rate and cannot overshoot available opposing balances
period filters are views only and all-time balance remains source-of-truth compatible
no chrono, Premium, paywall or billing behavior introduced
